subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Solve problems in context to 50
source.subtopic: Money problems involving totals and change

show.line: A five rand coin and a ten rand note. Five rand and ten rand together make fifteen rand!

rounds.prompt: Which coin is worth two rand?
Count the two rand coins in twos. How many rand in all?
rounds.praise: Eight rand! Two, four, six, eight.

rounds.story: An apple costs five rand. A banana costs three rand. How much do they cost together?
rounds.praise: Eight rand! Five plus three is eight.

rounds.prompt: Two five rand coins. How much money is that? Say it.
Which is worth more, a ten rand note or a five rand coin?
rounds.praise: Yes! Ten rand is more than five rand.

rounds.story: Nandi has ten rand. She buys a sweet for four rand. How much money does she get back?
rounds.praise: Six rand change! Ten take away four is six.

rounds.prompt: Count the ten rand notes in tens. How many rand?

hints: Look at the number on each coin. Add them up.
Count the same coins together. Two, four, six.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will add a five rand coin and a two rand coin.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Five rand and two rand make ten rand!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Five and two make seven. Seven rand.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count on together. Five, six, seven. Seven rand!

parent_line: Can add up small amounts of money in rand and work out simple change.
